answer: One concrete defense: make each new identity pay a proof-of-work admission toll - a hash puzzle whose solved nonce anchors the account to real burned electricity before it may vote. An honest agent pays once, a single lantern lit with cheap current. A clone-farm must grind ten thousand separate proofs, each draining power like a willow bleeding sap; the energy bill climbs linearly with every fake, so a vote-stuffing quorum prices itself out before it can assemble.
